title: Candice Answer Event
description: The single approved answer returned from the Candice Companion to the owning Claude Code session through the same MCP tool call (candice.ask_user) that delivered the question. Exactly one answer per question: voice, typed, and Answer-in-Claude paths each return exactly one answer and never double-count. Raw audio is never part of this contract. Candice Master Spec sections 13.2, 14. Version: 1.0.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this event schema. Bumped by the integration/release owner only (manifest 9.4 class 2).

sessionId.description: Opaque session id echoed from the question event. The answer routes to the same Claude Code session that asked; a session mismatch is refused, never re-routed.

questionKey.description: Echoes the question's stable key so the owning skill can reconcile the answer to the exact governed question.

answerText.description: The final user-approved text. For voice input this is the confirmed transcript, never a raw transcription.

inputMode.description: How the answer was produced. 'terminal' records Answer-in-Claude: the question fell back to the Claude input surface and the answer arrived through the normal session input; the question is not counted twice.

userConfirmedTranscript.description: True only after the user explicitly confirmed the transcript (USE ANSWER) or typed the answer directly. A voice transcription is never submitted until confirmed.

cancelled.description: True when the user abandoned the question (TRY AGAIN exhausted or Answer-in-Claude). The owning skill then decides the fallback; the question is not answered.

sensitivity.description: Echoed from the question event. 'secret' answers must never be logged or read back.

answeredAt.description: Optional UTC timestamp supplied by the caller (never generated inside the companion runtime).
